benchmark.name: ChroSift log diagnosis
benchmark.description: Does reducing failure logs preserve useful diagnosis and evidence?

metric.label: Mean diagnostic credit
metric.definition: Arithmetic mean of saved historical automatic diagnosis credits among scored answers. Unscored or skipped records remain missing, not zero.
